shortDescription: Serbia’s student-led movement, poised to take power after last month’s election, is urging banks to scrutinize capital flows out of the country during the transition to a new government, according to Bloomberg.

title: Serbia Student Movement Seeks Tighter Bank Checks on Capital Flows During Transition
